Name: Decorative Raptors
Author: judesann
Description:
[b]Decorative Raptors[/b]

Created and illustrated by [b]Judesan (my artistic name)[/b].

This content pack adds three ambient birds of prey to Stardew Valley through [i]Ornithologist's Guild[/i]:

- Bald Eagles, found throughout the year during the daytime.
- Red-tailed Hawks, found throughout the year during the daytime.
- Snowy Owls, found only during winter evenings and nights.

The birds are decorative wildlife managed by Ornithologist's Guild. They may
fly, perch, and react to the player using that mod's bird behavior system.
Each species includes a short original, Stardew-style call created specifically
for this content pack. No third-party field recordings are included.

[b]Dedication[/b]

The bald eagles in this content pack are lovingly dedicated to **Shadow and
Jackie of Big Bear Valley**. Their remarkable bond, resilience, and shared
story inspired this small tribute. Jackie will be deeply missed, and her
memory will continue to soar alongside Shadow.

[b]Required mods[/b]

- **SMAPI 4+**
- **Content Patcher 2+**
- **Ornithologist's Guild 1.9.8+**

Stardew Valley 1.6 or later is required by these mods.

[b]Installation[/b]

Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Ornithologist's Guild first. Then place the
`Decorative Raptors` folder inside your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder.

[b]Credits and permissions[/b]

Created, designed, and illustrated by [b]Judesan[/b].

Website: [url=https://judesanama.neocities.org/]Judesanama's blog[/url]judesanama.neocities.org]() / [url=https://judesan.com]Judesan webpage[/url]

All original bird artwork included with this content pack belongs to Judesan.
Please do not redistribute, reupload, sell, or use the sprites in other
projects without permission.

*Stardew Valley* was created by ConcernedApe. *Ornithologist's Guild* was
created by Ivy. This is an unofficial fan-made content pack and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe or Ivy.
